item.tib: dbal chen drag po rngam pa'i thugs rgyud las rtsang bstod rno dbal stobs ldan
item.coloph: drag po rtsang gi 'phrin las zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po'i thugs rjes mdzod bskul nas/ ye shes mtsho rgyal bka'i gnyer gtad nas/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyi (kyis/)phyi rabs las ldan gshen la brgyad pa dge legs 'phel/ dam nyams log lta can la ma shor cig sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//
